command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
cd /tmp/g/
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
printf 'e7b14228ce288a0e1870d8fa6ee29c021c508d8fcb96cb452f43adbddb205ca1  arms.sha256\nc8428eedbe7db56bb9608d13d763d3c6e205ca7164c06a4adf61286bc25b76c2  walks_probe.py\n' | sha256sum -c && sha256sum -c arms.sha256 || { echo 'FAIL: pins'; exit 1; }
mkdir -p /tmp/out /tmp/work
python3 -u walks_probe.py 60 9000 data /tmp/out 64 500 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered -v 'Warning\|deprecated behaviour' | tee /tmp/out/pe.log
exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}
